content.text: Car Dealership System
Overview

The Car Dealership System is designed to manage the inventory, sales, and customer interactions of a vehicle dealership. It tracks vehicles from acquisition to sale, manages customer leads, and records transaction details.
Requirements
Vehicle Management
The system shall store vehicle details including VIN, make, model, year, trim, mileage, and color.
The system shall track vehicle status (e.g., In Stock, Reserved, Sold, Out for Service).
The system shall allow for the categorization of vehicles (e.g., New, Used, Certified Pre-Owned).
The system shall store pricing information, including MSRP, dealer price, and minimum acceptable price.
Inventory Search
Users shall be able to search for vehicles based on make, model, year, price range, and body style.
The inventory list shall be updatable in real-time as vehicles are sold or added.
Customer & Lead Management
The system shall maintain a database of customers and potential leads.
Each lead shall track the interested vehicle, contact information, and communication history.
Sales & Transactions
The system shall record sales transactions, including the final sale price, date of sale, financing details, and the assigned sales representative.
The system shall generate a basic bill of sale or purchase agreement summary.
Open Questions
Should the system handle service and maintenance scheduling for sold vehicles?
Is integration with external vehicle history databases (like CARFAX) required for used inventory?
Should the system support multi-location dealership management?
